descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-21 Hospital vs. Nursing-Home Context Switch · S12 「快速点 养老院 → 医院 → 养老院：列表不过期、不混」 Rapid Nursing Home → Hospital → Nursing Home taps: no stale or mixed list

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U6 No data or template leakage between Hospital and Nursing Home. This covers lists, charts, the template picker, custom templates, account-wide screens (search, dashboard counts, Task Export, Inbox, mu …（UAT TC-21；TFA-92599 AC 5） — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given Hospital list open, fixture patients

When On a real phone, tap Nursing Home, Hospital and Nursing Home as fast as possible; also a fast mouse sequence on desktop web

Then The final list is the Nursing Home list with only the resident, no mixed rows from the previous context, and the saved setting is Nursing Home

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：A person checks the final screen. The 2026-10-10 agent Pass is not evidence: the agent acts one MCP call at a time, and each click waits for a new snapshot, so the race never happens.

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 人工（manual）

S12 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-21.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本；辅助：DEVICE · 真机（iOS / Android） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
